blocked.detail: CDP profile had stale MSSOAT cookie name but live session redirected to rio/sign-out (Logged out Successfully). Headed login wait timed out after 4 minutes. Sign into Foundit once via: bash scripts/launch-chrome-cdp.sh foundit then open https://www.foundit.in/rio/login

blockerSummary: Windows Chrome ABE: Foundit CDP profile needs one-time headed login at ~/.cursor/chrome-cdp-profiles/foundit (cookie-name check alone is insufficient)
